Centrelink Service Centres in Tasmania

10 service centres · Updated from public Australian Government dataset

Browse all 10 centres Call Centrelink 13 24 68

Tasmania has 10 Centrelink Service Centres operated by Services Australia. These centres provide in-person support for Centrelink payments, Medicare, NDIS, and Veterans Affairs services. Most can also be accessed online via myGov, but some trámites still need an in-person visit for identity verification or original documents.

Can I do this online instead?

Most Services Australia services in Tasmania can be accessed online through myGov. This includes claiming payments, updating personal details, uploading documents, reporting income, and managing your Medicare claims. In-person visits are typically only needed for:

  • Initial identity verification (especially for new claims)
  • Original document presentation (birth certificates, passports)
  • Complex situations requiring face-to-face assistance
  • Interpreter-assisted appointments

For more guidance, see services online vs. in-person.

Services available at Tasmania centres

  • Centrelink payments — JobSeeker, Age Pension, Family Tax Benefit, and 15+ other income support programs.
  • Medicare services — Medicare card, claims, enrolments, and family cover.
  • JobSeeker Payment — for unemployed Australians or those with reduced work capacity.
  • Age Pension — income support for eligible Australians of pension age.
  • Disability Support Pension — for those unable to work due to disability.
